notes.title: Dancing DLC is here
notes.content:
If you enjoyed the series and want to support the developer a little more, you can purchase this DLC which lets you turn any room in Snail Trek 4 into a disco. The ball drops, the snails can do the moonwalk, and the Zhawks bop a bit. :-)

http://store.steampowered.com/app/842820/Snail_Trek_4__Disco_Donation_DLC/
(Also accessible from the game's Snail menu)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32198700/cc0248a2da2f2209c6791e34f3c18e79eac6c21b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: One more patch
notes.content:
I've made another update that:
- fixes some parser bugs that people have reported (or provides better responses to some actions that make sense, or that need an explanation why they won't work).
- provides a few more gentle hints (if you look for them) about various puzzles that are stumping people a bit too much.
- prepares the game for some upcoming DLC!

notes.title: First patch
notes.content: I've released a patch that fixes an issue where you could get stuck in a certain room, and also adds a missing music credit. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: It's here! The conclusion to the epic snail saga
notes.content:
Please enjoy this final chapter of the Snail Trek series. It's the longest and most challenging of the bunch - definitely no longer a "20 minute adventure".

This one features switchable characters just like chapter 2 did. Also... a baby snail! Look how cute she is! I hope nothing happens to her...

As always, go to the discussion forums if you have any problems, or want hints on achievements or Easter eggs or other secret things (maybe...).

[b]ALSO[/b]: Chapters 1-3 will be on sale for the next 4 days, so now is a good time to buy the set (especially now that there is a bundle discount for the 4 games). Tell your friends!

Also, please check out cascadequestgame.com for information about my other game in progress.
